changes.comment: Rich text is lighter. A field decides when it opens whether it is read-only, and an edit never makes it read-only: the editor refuses an image dropped into a list, or `{% … %}` in a code block, and says why. A `{%` typed in other text stays text. Typing converts the text when you pause, and Save always sends the current text. Tiptap and Markdoc load only for a form with a rich-text field: the chunk that every form loads goes from 232 kB to 42 kB gzip.
